kind: Local deterministic tests only; no LIVE data, RLS or CAPTCHA acceptance
tests: Content approval covers business modules/source dependencies but never staff/settings/notifications or staging
All public readers retain anonymous client and publication/verification filters shared with backend contract
Returning SIGNED_IN and TOKEN_REFRESHED keep verified identity/revision/cache stable while validation runs
Background revalidation still fails closed on revocation and timeout; old expiry remains enforced
Role guard keeps Outlet mounted during background checks but rejects errors/revoked/mismatched staff
Draft recovery encrypts private fields, requires passphrase after discarded runtime and never stores plaintext or the key
Draft vault rejects security fields/files and removes recovered drafts after success or explicit clear
Draft ciphertext tampering and expiry cannot restore data
